positive.prompt: Write a Python endpoint that a mobile app can call to fetch open work orders for the logged-in technician
Set up a webhook so that every time a Sales Invoice is submitted, our warehouse system gets notified
Expose a REST endpoint with API key authentication so a third-party integration can create Customer records
Add rate limiting to our integration endpoint so it can't be hammered by external callers

negative.prompt: Add a validate controller that recalculates totals when a line item changes
Build a Vue 3 dashboard that shows live order counts using frappe-ui

evals.prompt: Write a whitelisted endpoint `get_open_tasks` that returns a list of open Task records for the current user, with fields: name, subject, due_date, priority. The call must respect document-level permissions.
evals.expected_output: A @frappe.whitelist decorated function using frappe.get_list with the correct parameters
expectations: Decorates the function with `@frappe.whitelist()` (without allow_guest unless explicitly requested)
Filters by `_assign` or `owner` to scope results to the current user via `frappe.session.user`
Does not pass `ignore_permissions=True`; lets the ORM enforce document-level permissions
Returns a JSON-serialisable list (get_list already returns dicts)

evals.prompt: Configure a Frappe webhook to POST a JSON payload to https://warehouse.example.com/api/inbound every time a Delivery Note is submitted. Include the document name and total_qty in the payload.
evals.expected_output: Steps to create the Webhook DocType record with the correct event, DocType, and field map
expectations: Instructs creating a Webhook record (Desk > Integrations > Webhooks) or via fixture JSON
Sets the webhook DocType to 'Delivery Note' and the event to 'on_submit'
Maps `name` and `total_qty` in the webhook field map or uses a request structure field
Notes that the target URL must be HTTPS and reachable from the Frappe server
Does not require custom Python code for a standard document event webhook
